sources: fail-secure default for admission control (quota check must reject when its dependency cannot answer)
bounded queue with backpressure (queue.Queue maxsize semantics: reject when full)
at-least-once acknowledgement: acknowledge only after the durable write is confirmed

defects.description: check_quota() catches every Exception from client.used_today() and returns True. Input: quota client raises TimeoutError (or HttpQuotaClient gets HTTP 503), incoming=50 -> check_quota returns True and EventWorker.submit() queues 50 events (depth 50). R2 requires rejection (QuotaExceeded, depth 0). An outage therefore disables the per-site limit.

defects.class: unbounded queue (missing bound and missing QueueFull path)
defects.description: EventQueue.put() appends with no depth check, and no QueueFull is defined in events.py. settings.py defines no QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH (hasattr is False), so the bound required by R3 (5000) exists nowhere. Input: 10000 put() calls with no consumer -> depth 10000 (R3 expects 5000 accepted, the rest rejected with QueueFull). Memory grows with the backlog without limit.

defects.class: swallowed write failure acknowledged as processed
defects.description: run_once() catches the store exception, logs it and falls through to mark_done(batch) and written_total accounting. Input: 3 pending events, store.write_batch raises OSError('disk full') -> run_once returns 3, queue depth 0, in_flight 0, written_total 0. The 3 events are acknowledged and lost; R4 requires restore to pending (depth 3) with the error logged.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: is_writable() catches OSError from open() and returns False, so an unwritable store fails closed for the caller. Input: path under a missing directory -> returns False (checked).
ReplayBuffer uses queue.Queue with maxsize, so the bound is enforced. Input: ReplayBuffer(2) offered 3 events -> [True, True, False] (checked).
write_batch() logs the OSError and re-raises it, so the failure is not hidden from the caller. Input: unwritable path -> FileNotFoundError propagates (checked).

is_writable opens the store in append mode, which creates an empty store file as a side effect of the probe (verified: exists() False before, True after). Unchanged line, not in change.diff, so a diff-mode review must not report it.

accepted_extras.description: day_key uses local clock (R5 says UTC); reached by the new check_quota path, so newly exposed. Audit-confirmed.
submit check-then-act without lock; admission ignores already queued events (conditional on quota service semantics).
